# ecg_dsp: fixed-point signal processing (pure C, no hardware).
# Coefficients and delays are generated by tools/dsp_design/design_filters.py.
add_library(ecg_dsp STATIC
  src/biquad.c
  src/decim.c
  src/dsp_util.c
  src/ecg_disp.c
  src/ecg_mon.c
  src/hrv.c
  src/mains.c
  src/pat.c
  src/ppg.c
  src/ppg_ctrl.c
  src/qrs.c
)
target_include_directories(ecg_dsp PUBLIC include PRIVATE src)
target_link_libraries(ecg_dsp PUBLIC ecg_iface)

if(NOT ECG_TARGET)
  add_library(ecg_dsp_synth STATIC tests/synth.c)
  target_link_libraries(ecg_dsp_synth PUBLIC ecg_dsp ecg_iface m)
  target_include_directories(ecg_dsp_synth PUBLIC tests)

  foreach(t decim ecg_disp mains qrs hrv ecg_mon ppg ppg_ctrl pat)
    ecg_add_test(dsp_test_${t} SOURCES tests/test_${t}.c LIBS ecg_dsp ecg_dsp_synth)
    target_include_directories(dsp_test_${t} PRIVATE src)
  endforeach()

  # The checked-in generated headers must match the design script.
  find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter QUIET)
  if(Python3_FOUND)
    execute_process(COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -c "import numpy, scipy"
                    RESULT_VARIABLE ECG_DSP_PY_OK OUTPUT_QUIET ERROR_QUIET)
    if(ECG_DSP_PY_OK EQUAL 0)
      add_test(NAME dsp_coefs_current
               COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} tools/dsp_design/design_filters.py --check
               WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR})
    endif()
  endif()
endif()
